meta.name: Beauty in Black
meta.description: La vida de una estríper da un giro cuando se cruza con una familia adinerada pero disfuncional que maneja una marca de cosméticos... y una nefasta operación ilegal.

videos.title: Que lluevan billetes
videos.overview: En un intento por escapar del club de striptease y del control de Jules, Kimmie solicita una beca en la escuela de peluquería Beauty in Black, fundada por la familia Bellarie.

videos.title: Bailando con papá
videos.overview: Mallory y Roy intentan sortear una serie de acontecimientos caóticos. Kimmie desafía las órdenes para ayudar a Rain y forja un pacto con un poderoso y reservado cliente.

videos.title: Las consecuencias
videos.overview: Las decisiones de Kimmie acarrean peligrosas consecuencias. La tensión crece entre los Bellary mientras Norman, furioso, busca respuestas sobre el atropello.

videos.title: Un asunto de familia
videos.overview: Olivia juega duro para proteger a sus hijos. Angel se acerca a Kimmie con una atrevida propuesta. A medida que la demanda se intensifica, Mallory contempla sus opciones.

videos.title: Hilos sueltos
videos.overview: Después de que el mundo de Angel se tambalee, Kimmie reconsidera su idea. Jules mueve los hilos de la familia. Enfrentado a una difícil elección, las sospechas de Norman crecen.

videos.title: Bang, bang
videos.overview: El ego de Roy alcanza nuevas cotas mientras Mallory caza a su «otra mujer». Kimmie y Angel buscan una salida. El dolor de Norman da un giro sangriento.

videos.title: Igualdad de condiciones
videos.overview: Harta de Roy, Mallory toma cartas en el asunto. Mientras Norman busca la verdad, aparece una cara conocida. Kimmie y Angel mueven ficha.

videos.title: Karma mortal
videos.overview: Los planes y los secretos se cierran en círculo cuando Horace conecta los puntos detrás del robo, Mallory afirma su dominio y Kimmie llega a su punto de ruptura.

videos.title: Blind Rage
videos.overview: Emotions run high as the Bellarie family grieves and schemes. Fueled by vengeance, Kimmie begins a desperate search for her kidnapped sister, Sylvie.

videos.title: Power Struggle
videos.overview: Kimmie's hunt for clues leads to a hostile reunion. Jules does what he does best: clean up the mess. Horace zeroes in on Norman's criminal dealings.

videos.title: Up Against the Wall
videos.overview: A worsening lawsuit is the least of Mallory's problems as Horace sows chaos. Kimmie takes her search for Sylvie to dangerous new heights.

videos.title: Hot Seat
videos.overview: Jules and his men search for Kimmie. Angel plays a precarious game to stay alive. Varney finds himself in the crosshairs of another Bellarie scandal.

videos.title: By Any Means
videos.overview: Horace proposes a deal to help Kimmie find Sylvie. Can she trust him? Meanwhile, Angel makes a disturbing discovery in the club.

videos.title: Wild Ride
videos.overview: Money talks when Mallory traces Roy's infidelity back to the strip club. A brazen attempt to rescue Sylvie drags Kimmie into deeper danger.

videos.title: The Lion's Den
videos.overview: Horace's endgame puts the Bellaries on high alert. Olivia bides her time. Angel and Rain contemplate next steps. Kimmie inadvertently makes the news.

videos.title: Now Make It Thunder
videos.overview: The tables turn when Horace asks Kimmie for help. Astounded, the Bellaries scramble to maintain their hold on their empire.

videos.title: Crowned in Beauty
videos.overview: Kimmie's sudden rise sends shockwaves through the Bellarie empire, as Horace's backroom maneuvers hit the family where it hurts most — the bottom line.

videos.title: When the Tables Turn
videos.overview: Kimmie, Rain and Sylvie enjoy their luxurious new lifestyle. Roy uses his leverage to dominate a rival. Things get ugly as Jules and Angel square off.

videos.title: Blaze of Beauty
videos.overview: A sibling showdown exposes grudges too deep to reconcile. Norman takes care of unfinished business. Olivia crashes a dinner for two.

videos.title: The Next Chapter
videos.overview: A deadly development shatters Kimmie's trust. At Delinda's, a dancer targets a VIP for a potential payday. Rain pumps Alex for info on Angel.

videos.title: Hunter's Prey
videos.overview: A meeting with Horace pulls Kimmie deeper into the game. Rain hits the club with a score to settle. Charles brings home more than he bargained for.

videos.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
videos.overview: Rain and Alex handle cleanup duty. A vicious insult leaves Roy dripping with rage. Kimmie's poolside breakfast comes with a side of shade.

videos.title: Gloves Off
videos.overview: Fireworks ignite at the office as Kimmie shows the Bellaries who's boss. A rugged ranch hand welcomes Sylvie to the stables. Jules smells a rat.

videos.title: Hold the Pleasantries
videos.overview: The boardroom becomes a battlefield as Kimmie and the family face off. Charles and Rain make impulsive decisions with dangerous consequences.

videos.title: Toxic Vibes
videos.overview: A violent wake-up call leaves Charles shaken and desperate. Kimmie attempts to control the narrative. Felicia and Mallory strike a bargain.

videos.title: Playing for Keeps
videos.overview: A tense dinner puts Kimmie and Sylvie's bond to the test. Olivia proves that loyalty has a price. Angel's new lifestyle fuels his worst instincts.

videos.title: Fed Up
videos.overview: Roy spirals out in public. Unwanted guests hammer home a warning to Olivia. Kimmie tries to keep her cards close as Jules runs game.

videos.title: Flames of Fury
videos.overview: Angel discovers Horace's generosity has limits. Charles overplays his hand with Varney. Kimmie and Mallory have a meeting of the minds.

videos.title: Boom!
videos.overview: Kimmie's mandate puts Charles and Roy at risk. Rain takes on an ambitious business venture. A shocking revelation upends Norman's world.

videos.title: Your Turn Is Coming
videos.overview: Kimmie cautiously weighs an unlikely alliance. Jules menaces a suspect who knows more than she's saying. A stakeout turns into a white-knuckle pursuit.

videos.title: The Power of Us
videos.overview: Hungry for payback, three queens deliver an overdue reckoning. Left high and dry, Angel pleads for mercy. Norman presses Olivia for answers.

videos.title: Queen's Gambit
videos.overview: Kimmie and the Bellaries face off at an explosive shareholder summit, where secrets spill, loyalties fray — and the sharpest move is saved for last.

videos.title: King In Play
videos.overview: In the wake of the FBI raid, an immunity deal pits the Bellaries against each other. Meanwhile, Kimmie and Horace celebrate a fragile victory.

videos.title: Gotcha
videos.overview: Rain discovers that her takeover of the club comes with strings attached. Roy offers up info to the feds. Angel tries to get back on Horace's good side.

videos.title: Throne Of Blood
videos.overview: Olivia discovers her cellmates aren't strangers while Norman applies leverage to a bureau contact. Kimmie's attempt at seduction shakes things up.

videos.title: A Tender Betrayal
videos.overview: Varney makes a play to extract information from Olivia. Tensions boil over at the mansion when Sylvie threatens to reveal an explosive truth.

videos.title: Devil In The Details
videos.overview: While Horace uncovers a vicious betrayal, Charles maneuvers to secure his own safety. Mallory warms up to an unexpected new man in her life.

videos.title: A Pack Of Wolves
videos.overview: The Bellaries' feud reaches deadly new heights. Horace meets with Jules and demands answers. Rain's power trip at the club grows reckless and violent.

videos.title: The Looking Glass
videos.overview: A stunning secret comes to light as Horace leads Charles and Varney behind closed doors. While crises tear at Kimmie, Jules schemes for his freedom.

videos.title: Dancing In The Rain
videos.overview: As the Bellarie empire teeters on the brink, Kimmie and Mallory struggle to contain the fallout while chaos and bloodshed close in from all sides.
